diffs.diff: pin count: part has 6 (GND 3.3V SDA SCL SDO/SA0 CS), datasheet reading has 11 (CS SDO/SA0 SCL SDA VDD GND INT2 INT1 OCS SCX SDX)
diffs.evidence: The SparkFun SEN-13339 board has two headers. Its Eagle board file has top-silkscreen (layer 21) labels on a 6-pin row at x=6.35, 8.89, 11.43, 13.97, 16.51 and 19.05 mm, reading GND, 3.3V, SDA/SDI, SCL, SDO/SA0, CS. A separate 5-pin row at y=20.24 reads INT2, INT1, OCS, SCX, SDX. The hookup guide says: 'The bare-minimum connections required are broken out on the left side of the board. These are the power and I2C pins ... GND, VDD, SDA/SDI, SCL, SDO/SA0, CS'. It also says: 'The remaining pins are broken out on the other side ... INT2, INT1, OCS, SCX, SDX' and 'This function is not covered in this tutorial.' The part models the main 6-pin header, with names and order matching the silkscreen (the power pin is printed '3.3V', which the guide calls VDD). Its description says the second 5-pin header is not modelled. The second reading listed all 11 pins across both headers, so both readings agree on every pin the part models. No pin is wrong or missing from the modelled 6x1 header.
